local:sleep-handoff-mode-needs-a-main-ch.title:
SkillOpt's own plugin README, re-read at commit 93bdf3d7: "PyPI 0.2.0
provides the base Sleep CLI, but handoff mode and `--preferences` require a
source checkout from `main` until the next release."

The Python dependency and source manifest now use the exact reviewed main commit,
so the needed feature set is reproducible. Re-check on the next release: once
handoff mode ships to PyPI the VCS dependency may be replaceable by a release pin.

RE-PROBED 2026-08-05 at the v0.2.0 review: upstream's latest release is STILL
v0.2.0 (no "next release" yet), and the claim is still in the pinned clone at
61735e39 (`plugins/claude-code/README.md:59`). The `main` pin therefore remains
the required shape, and the engine's "'main' -> 'v0.2.0' could not be parsed"
ambiguity is a version-string artifact, not a pending upgrade: the pinned
commit post-dates the tag. Re-probed 2026-08-13 at 93bdf3d7; the latest release
is still v0.2.0, so version metadata alone remains non-authoritative. Item stays open.

local:sleep-writes-outside-this-project.title:
SkillOpt-Sleep's upstream SessionEnd hook appends to
`~/.skillopt-sleep/session-end.log` (async, exit 0, no API spend, verified by
reading `hooks/on-session-end.sh` at 93bdf3d7), and the consolidation cycle
proposes edits to `CLAUDE.md` / `SKILL.md` files. The mutable marketplace plugin
is disabled locally, so neither surface is active in this provenance-only slice.

Nothing is written live until a human runs `/skillopt-sleep adopt`, and every
adopt backs up the prior file. That review is the control: `do-not.md` #11 keeps
this repo out of `~/.claude`, and an unreviewed self-edit would route around it.
Re-read the hook on every version bump — a change from marker-append to anything
that spends budget or writes a tracked file is a different bargain.

RE-PROBED 2026-08-05 at the v0.2.0 review: `plugins/claude-code/hooks/
on-session-end.sh` re-read at the pinned 93bdf3d7 — still exactly a
timestamp+PWD append to `~/.skillopt-sleep/session-end.log`, unconditional
`exit 0`, no API spend, no tracked-file write. Same bargain. Also noted from
the v0.2.0 notes: "Redact secrets before persisting cycle diagnostics" — a fix
in the right direction for the surface this item watches.
